Term1: Cardiac Surgery MRSA/MSSA Decolonization Protocol Pre-Op
Text:
# Cardiac Surgery MRSA/MSSA Decolonization Protocol Pre-Op

# Outpatient

Chlorhexidine 4% liquid topically Q24h ($) M < AND > Mupirocin 2%
ointment topically Q12h ($) [M]

# Inpatient

If patient is discharged prior to surgery, place outpatient orders as well
Chlorhexidine 4% liquid topically Q24h ($) M nursing text order

< AND > Mupirocin 2% ointment topically Q12h ($) [M]

# References:

- Up-To-Date article: Methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) in adults: Prevention and control
